scope.purpose: Diagnose redundant XP adjustment and verify grave replacement without duplication, including missing inventory slots.
scope.fixture: Explicit first_join; frozen dedicated world; direct private function boundary calls for observation, not example API usage. MP/XP configured then production check is traced. Synthetic marker and GraveStoreItems stand in for a saved grave; actual grave recovery and inventory API run unchanged.
notVerified: Natural death/grave creation or contact detection

steps.name: Fixture: explicit player initialization, no natural-login assertion
commands: gamerule doMobSpawning false
gamerule doDaylightCycle false
gamemode creative VerifyIdioms
execute as VerifyIdioms at @s run function core:handler/first_join
fill -3 79 -3 3 79 3 stone
tp VerifyIdioms 0.5 80 0.5
clear VerifyIdioms
scoreboard objectives add IdiomVerify dummy
execute if entity @a[name=VerifyIdioms] run scoreboard players set FIXTURE_READY IdiomVerify 1

steps.name: Prepare stable MP/XP state: positive_first
commands: scoreboard players set VerifyIdioms MP 500
scoreboard players set VerifyIdioms MPMax 1000
execute as VerifyIdioms run function api:data_get/invalidate_cache
execute as VerifyIdioms run function player_manager:mp/viewer/check_xpbar
execute as VerifyIdioms run function api:data_get/invalidate_cache
execute store result score #level IdiomVerify run xp query VerifyIdioms levels
execute if score VerifyIdioms MP matches 500 if score #level IdiomVerify matches 50 run scoreboard players set POSITIVE_FIRST_BASELINE_OK IdiomVerify 1

steps.name: Trace actual check_xpbar call: positive_first
commands: execute as VerifyIdioms at @s run debug function player_manager:mp/viewer/check_xpbar
xp query VerifyIdioms levels
data get entity VerifyIdioms XpP

execute as VerifyIdioms run function api:data_get/invalidate_cache

Prepare stable MP/XP state: zero_control
commands: scoreboard players set VerifyIdioms MP 0
scoreboard players set VerifyIdioms MPMax 1000
execute as VerifyIdioms run function api:data_get/invalidate_cache
execute as VerifyIdioms run function player_manager:mp/viewer/check_xpbar

data get entity VerifyIdioms XpP

steps.name: Separate zero-MP trace from grave trace
Fixture grave contents: missing_slots
commands: kill @e[type=item]
clear VerifyIdioms
item replace entity VerifyIdioms armor.head with diamond_helmet{IdiomVerify:"grave_helmet"} 1
item replace entity VerifyIdioms weapon.offhand with emerald{IdiomVerify:"grave_offhand"} 1
item replace entity VerifyIdioms inventory.18 with gold_ingot{IdiomVerify:"grave_slot27"} 7
item replace entity VerifyIdioms hotbar.0 with dirt{IdiomVerify:"grave_hotbar"} 9
tag VerifyIdioms add GraveOwner
execute as VerifyIdioms run function api:data_get/invalidate_cache
execute as VerifyIdioms run function oh_my_dat:please
data modify storage oh_my_dat: _[-4][-4][-4][-4][-4][-4][-4][-4].GraveStoreItems set value [{Slot:0b,id:"minecraft:stone",Count:1b}]
summon marker 10.5 80 0.5 {Tags:["IdiomVerify.Grave"]}
data get entity VerifyIdioms Inventory
execute if entity @e[type=marker,tag=IdiomVerify.Grave,limit=1] run scoreboard players set GRAVE_FIXTURE_READY IdiomVerify 1

execute if data entity VerifyIdioms Inventory[{Slot:103b,id:"minecraft:diamond_helmet"}] if data entity VerifyIdioms Inventory[{Slot:-106b,id:"minecraft:emerald"}] if data entity VerifyIdioms Inventory[{Slot:27b,id:"minecraft:gold_ingot"}] run scoreboard players set SLOTS_PREPARED IdiomVerify 1

steps.name: Execute production grave recovery boundary: missing_slots
commands: execute as @e[type=marker,tag=IdiomVerify.Grave,limit=1] at @s run debug function player_manager:grave/tick/break
data get entity VerifyIdioms Inventory
execute positioned 10.5 80 0.5 as @e[type=item,distance=..3] run data get entity @s Item
execute unless entity @e[type=marker,tag=IdiomVerify.Grave] run scoreboard players set GRAVE_RECOVERED IdiomVerify 1

steps.name: Measure inventory and ground independently: missing_slots
commands: execute store result score #helmet_inventory IdiomVerify run clear VerifyIdioms minecraft:diamond_helmet{IdiomVerify:"grave_helmet"} 0
execute positioned 10.5 80 0.5 store result score #helmet_ground IdiomVerify if entity @e[type=item,distance=..3,nbt={Item:{id:"minecraft:diamond_helmet",Count:1b,tag:{IdiomVerify:"grave_helmet"}}}]
scoreboard players get #helmet_inventory IdiomVerify
scoreboard players get #helmet_ground IdiomVerify
execute store result score #offhand_inventory IdiomVerify run clear VerifyIdioms minecraft:emerald{IdiomVerify:"grave_offhand"} 0
execute positioned 10.5 80 0.5 store result score #offhand_ground IdiomVerify if entity @e[type=item,distance=..3,nbt={Item:{id:"minecraft:emerald",Count:1b,tag:{IdiomVerify:"grave_offhand"}}}]
scoreboard players get #offhand_inventory IdiomVerify
scoreboard players get #offhand_ground IdiomVerify
execute store result score #slot27_inventory IdiomVerify run clear VerifyIdioms minecraft:gold_ingot{IdiomVerify:"grave_slot27"} 0
execute positioned 10.5 80 0.5 store result score #slot27_ground IdiomVerify if entity @e[type=item,distance=..3,nbt={Item:{id:"minecraft:gold_ingot",Count:7b,tag:{IdiomVerify:"grave_slot27"}}}]

execute if data entity VerifyIdioms Inventory[{Slot:0b,id:"minecraft:stone",Count:1b}] run scoreboard players set SAVED_HOTBAR_RESTORED IdiomVerify 1
